**Build passes now, exit 0.** Two real bugs, not noise.

`resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but the bump renamed it `retryCount`. It now takes either, default `0`. See [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6).

`isBackoffEnabled` threw on an unset flag. The new loader gives `undefined`, not `false`. Unset now means off. See [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7).

The 8 warnings left are print statements inside [build.js:18](build.js:18). They name files that do not exist here.

Next: nothing, unless you want those warning lines gone too.
